notes.title: Update 3 is public now
notes.content:
Whats new:

1. Save slots. Also you can erase your progress if you ever will so.
2. Sticker sorting by name(asc and desc) in sticker bag and main game screen.
3. Bug fix for hints.

Thank you for playing Sticker Craft
